FILENAME= 'NRCB3_17011_IPCDeconvolutionKernel_2016-03-18_ssbipc.fits' / Name of
TELESCOP= 'JWST    '           / Telescope used to acquire the data
Instrument configuration information
INSTRUME= 'NIRCAM  '           / Instrument used to acquire the data
DETECTOR= 'NRCB3   '           / Name of detector used to acquire the data
MODULE  = 'B       '           / NIRCam module: A or B
CHANNEL = 'SHORT   '           / NIRCam channel: long or short
Subarray parameters
SUBARRAY= 'FULL    '           / Subarray used
SUBSTRT1=                    1 / Starting pixel in axis 1 direction
SUBSTRT2=                    1 / Starting pixel in axis 2 direction
SUBSIZE1=                 2048 / Number of pixels in axis 1 direction
SUBSIZE2=                 2048 / Number of pixels in axis 2 direction
Information about the reference file
REFTYPE = 'IPC     '           / Reference file type
DESCRIP = 'IPC Deconvolution kernel' / Description of the reference file
COMMENT FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) format is defined in 'Astronomy
COMMENT and Astrophysics', volume 376, page 359; bibcode 2001A&A...376..359H
DESCRIPT= 'IPC Deconvolution kernel'
AUTHOR  = 'NIRCam Instrument Team'
PEDIGREE= 'GROUND  '
TERROIR = 'ISIMCV3 '           / Test environment
SCA     = 'B3      '           / NIRCAM SCA identification (kept for compatibili
TLDYNEID= '17011   '           / Numeric SCA identifier
ALPHA   =     0.00550419976935 / Capacitive coupling constant, nearest neighbors
BETA    =    0.000269599986495 / Capacitive coupling constant, next nearest neig
GAMMA   =     0.00550419976935 / Capacitive coupling constant, downstream readou
ASSYMKER=                    0 / Is de-convoluation symmetric? (ALPHA=GAMMA)
KSIZE   =                    3 / Size of (square) de-convolution kernel
DOCUMENT= 'IPC_v3_20160315.pdf' / Document describing this cal file.
SOFTWRE0= 'genipccal.pro'      / Software used to derive cal file.
DATAUSED= ' See DOCUMENT'      / Data sets used to derive cal file.
FASTAXIS=                    1
SLOWAXIS=                   -2
HISTORY  Description of Reference File Creation
HISTORY  In the FITS extension is the g kernel as described
HISTORY  in McCullough, ISR WFC3 2008-26 and DOCUMENT keyword.
HISTORY  The kernel in the extension should be convolved
HISTORY  with the image frame by frame prior to any other
HISTORY  processing.
HISTORY  If ASSYMKER, asymmetry is assumed to be in the sense
HISTORY  of a left to right readout (e.g. outputs 1 and 3)
HISTORY  When applied to outputs 2 and 4, kernel should be
HISTORY  flipped in x-dimension.
HISTORY  Reference pixels should not be convoled
HISTORY  with the kernel. The kernel size has been chosen
HISTORY  such that edges extend into reference pixels and so
HISTORY  edge detection should not be necessary.
HISTORY This file was delivered by the NIRCam team from the University of Arizon
HISTORY a. File was modified by B. Brooks to be compliant with CRDS and JWST Pip
HISTORY eline standards.
